note: Attacker-controlled low 32 bits of the uncompressed size are read from the RAR file header.
Combining attacker-controlled HighUnpSize (bit 63 set) with LowUnpSize makes the int64 UnpSize negative.
Negative DestUnpSize (uncompressed size) is cast to unsigned int, producing an oversized write length (e.g. 0xFFFFFFFF).
Write with the oversized Count reads far beyond the small heap Buffer, causing a heap-buffer-overflow read.
